create_noisy_cloze_translation: create a noisy cloze question by shuffling, dropping, and blanking tokens then adding a wh-word and question mark
create_identity_translation: create an identity cloze question by replacing the answer span with a wh-word and appending a question mark
build_noiser_params: build a NoiserParams object with configurable word shuffle, dropout, blank rates, and blank word token
test_word_shuffle: test the word shuffle function that randomly permutes token order using uniform noise and argsort
test_word_dropout: test the word dropout function that randomly removes tokens based on a keep probability threshold
